# `silk/testing`

<!-- Generated by packages/compiler/scripts/generate-documentation.mjs. Do not edit by hand. -->

Profiles: `aarch64-apple-darwin`, `aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu`, `aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu-no-libc`, `wasm32-unknown-unknown`, `x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu`, `x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu-no-libc`.

Minimal source-defined test assertions and runtime selection predicates.

## When to use

Mark a parameterless unit function with `test`, then use [`expect`](#declaration-73696c6b2f74657374696e673a3a54657374696e672e657870656374) for a boolean condition.
Custom runners may reuse [`matches`](#declaration-73696c6b2f74657374696e673a3a54657374696e672e6d617463686573) to apply the builtin runner's file and name policy.

## Details

Assertions are ordinary typed failures. They require no service and carry the caller's borrowed
diagnostic message. Runtime filters are literal: file paths compare exactly, while names use
ASCII-only case folding and bytewise substring matching.

Import as `Testing` with `import silk.testing { Testing }`.
